name: openwave
description: Autonomic wake-up memory for OpenClaw agents. Injects identity, goals and query-relevant recall into every turn, and runs the sleep system (consolidation, awake replay, extraction) in-process. Powered by sharpwave-core.

agents.description: OpenClaw agent ids openwave serves. Each routes to ~/.sharpwave/<id>/brain.db.

curatedTierDedupe.description: When true (default), pass externalMemoryActive to sharpwave-core when MEMORY.md/USER.md is present so durable identity/goals are not double-injected.

consolidationCron.description: Host cron expression for openwave:consolidation (LLM consolidation). Staggered after memory-core dreaming (0 3 * * *).

consolidationCronEnabled.description: When true (default), register openwave:consolidation on gateway_start. Still registered when dreaming is disabled.

emotionalProfile.description: Reserved for sharpwave-core's valence/arousal split (not yet shipped -- see research/emotional-memory-openclaw-integration.md proposal 3). Accepted and stored but has no runtime effect until sharpwave-core exposes these fields on computeSalience.

personaOverrides.description: Per-agent-id overrides layered over the flat config above, keyed by OpenClaw agent id (e.g. "mila"). Mirrors the agents.entries.<id> override idiom (docs/gateway/config-agents/entries-and-multi-agent.md) applied to openwave's own config. Missing keys inherit the flat value above; emotionalProfile fields are accepted ahead of the engine work that will consume them.

brainMode.description: local (default): open ~/.sharpwave/<agent>/brain.db in-process, exactly as before. remote: use the SharpWave brain service (sharpwave-server) over MCP Streamable HTTP at brainUrl; no local brain.db is opened, and local sleep, the openwave:consolidation host cron and the hourly local harvest are disabled (the service owns sleep).

brainUrl.description: Remote mode: base URL of the brain service (MCP endpoint is <brainUrl>/mcp, health is <brainUrl>/health).

brainTokenFile.description: Remote mode (preferred): path to a file containing the per-agent bearer token minted by `sharpwave-server token mint`. `~` and `{agentId}` are expanded, so one entry can serve several agents (e.g. ~/.sharpwave/tokens/{agentId}.token). Takes precedence over $OPENWAVE_BRAIN_TOKEN and brainToken.

brainToken.description: Remote mode (discouraged): inline bearer token. Prefer brainTokenFile or the OPENWAVE_BRAIN_TOKEN env var so the secret is not stored in openclaw.json. Never logged.

sharedRecall.description: Remote mode: include the shared brain (visibility shared) in per-turn recall alongside the agent private brain.

remoteTimeoutMs.description: Remote mode: per-call budget for the brain service. If the service does not answer in time the turn proceeds with no recall injected.
